messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled v2 rollout to EU Dedicated pool starting 2024-06-12T22:00Z (deploy id: 20240612-v2-782). Ramp: 10% -> 30% -> 100% over ~15m. Watchlist: p95/p99 latency, 5xx, SDK transport errors. Please keep eyes on canary dashboards. :eyes:

Sasha: seeing a small but consistent p95 bump on eu-west-1 dedicated canaries (approx +40ms). Not huge but above our normal noise window. Logs show increased KV cache misses around same time.

Mike: confirmed. Sample log snippet: `runtime.kvcache.misses+=1.2%` during warmup. I ran a quick compare vs hosted canary and the dedicated nodes are missing a cache pin on startup.

Anya: recommendation: pause the EU dedicated ramp, keep hosted rollout going for now. We should pin existing tenants that depend on Dedicated performance SLA.

deploy-bot: Pausing ramp for EU Dedicated. Changing target -> hold at 10% canary for now.

Leah: I'll assemble a temporary pinlist for affected customers from last week's usage spike. Proposed pin list: `acme-inc`, `edu-platform`, `healthpay`. Any objections?

Ryan: no objections. Add `marketplace-eu` too — they reported higher latencies in last test.

deploy-bot: Adding pins now and annotating deploy record. Command run: 
```
deployctl pin --tenant acme-inc --until 2024-06-13T04:00Z --reason "v2 eu latency"
deployctl pin --tenant edu-platform --until 2024-06-13T04:00Z --reason "v2 eu latency"
deployctl pin --tenant healthpay --until 2024-06-13T04:00Z --reason "v2 eu latency"
deployctl pin --tenant marketplace-eu --until 2024-06-13T04:00Z --reason "v2 eu latency"
```
Pins applied. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Observability note: alert rule `eu-dedicated-p99-latency` fired at 22:03Z (p99 +120ms). No 5xx spike yet.

Mike: quick mitigation idea: small hotpatch to increase KV cache prefetch window on dedicated nodes (change is config-only + safe). I can test in canary container now.

Anya: go for it. If the hotpatch reduces p95 by >20ms on canaries within 10m, we consider slow ramp resume. If not, we keep hold and do deeper runtime investigation.

Mike: deploying hotpatch to the 10% dedicated canaries now. Patch id: runtime-hotpatch-20240612-kv-prefetch-1.

Sasha: also update release notes to flag the EU dedicated hold and pinlist so Sales/CS don't get surprised. Add a small Troubleshooting blurb for customers on Dedicated SLOs.

Leah: I'll notify Customer Success and add an internal note to the release doc. Suggested phrasing: "EU Dedicated rollout temporarily held due to elevated tail latency on a small subset of canaries; targeted hotpatch in progress; affected tenants temporarily pinned to v1."

deploy-bot: Hotpatch deployed to canary. Monitoring 10m window.

ops-bot: Monitoring update (22:12Z): p95 reduced ~18ms on patched canaries, p99 still elevated +80ms. No 5xx increase.

Anya: improvement but not yet within target. Next steps: allow another 20m to observe, if p99 moves under threshold we'll resume ramp to 30%. If p99 stays high or 5xx increases, we'll rollback and escalate to runtime-alloc team.

Ryan: Rollback criteria reminder for this thread (agreed):
- Any sustained 5xx rate >0.5% for 5m
- p99 latency breach >150ms above baseline for 10m
- SDK error spike (transport/connectivity) >2x baseline for 5m
If hit, immediate rollback to v1 for Dedicated and notify on-call.

Sasha: linking the release note PR and internal ops checklist here: https://git.internal/release/v2-eu-dedicated (PR 4123).

Leah: CS pinged and updated CS-playbook; they will reach out to top 10 affected accounts proactively.

Mike: will run deeper heap/kv profiling if p99 doesn't drop further. Also checking kernel and driver versions — a small allocation pattern change may expose different behavior on our dedicated instance types.

Anya: thanks. Everyone, please hold any further ramp changes in this channel. We'll reconvene in 30m or on-call if alerts escalate.

deploy-bot: Noted. Ticket created: RN-20240612-EU-HOLD. Adding timeline to deploy record.

Leah: added internal status update to release notes (ops section). Tagging @release-engineering to review wording before publishing external notes.

release-engineering: acked. We will hold external release note publish until we've confirmed ramp to 30% or decide on rollback.

ops-bot: Final monitoring snapshot at 22:35Z: p95 back within +5-10ms, p99 trending down but still +50ms. No 5xx. Recommend allow additional 15m before resuming to 30%.

Anya: agreed. Resuming in 15m if trend continues. Action items: Mike follow profiler trace, Sasha update RN PR with hold note, Leah coordinate CS messages, Ryan document rollback criteria in deploy ticket.

deploy-bot: Thread closed for now, will update when ramp resumes or on any alert.
